items.title: JJ Johnson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I don’t recall that Oliver ever had a chance to do a feature film. His forte was mostly television.

ctx.x: It had a lot of stuff on it. Fact is, you do Stolen Moments on that.
Right. Oliver Nelson's Stolen Moments. Right. The producer on those occasions I remember was Jack Somer, S-O-M-E-R.
